### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High — international personality research authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — diversity in personality samples |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Personality theory — Big Five / HEXACO structure, narrative identity (McAdams tradition), personality development, individual differences process |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must contribute to **understanding of personality structure, process, or development** with empirical rigor. Narrative identity work is a distinctive Journal of Personality strength.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts without personality contribution redirected; single-study designs face scrutiny.

### Methodological Preferences

| Method | Receptiveness (0-5) | Evidence |
|--------|---------------------|----------|
| Quantitative experimental | 5 | Core method |
| Qualitative interviews | 3 | Welcomed in narrative-identity tradition (McAdams approach) |
| Autoethnography | 1 | Rare |
| Theoretical / Conceptual | 4 | Theoretical personality work welcomed |
| Mixed methods | 4 | Narrative + quantitative common pattern |
| Meta-analysis | 4 | 9 article(s) found (OpenAlex keyword search, 2021-2026, 494 total in window; 1.8%) — shows the journal does publish this, but uncommonly — the high rating is a family-level estimate that this output rate does not by itself support |
| Psychometric / Factor analytic | 5 | Distinctive strength |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside personality scope
- AI use without disclosure per Wiley policy
- Pure single-study without theoretical contribution

### Soft Tax

Low for personality-tradition empirical authors. Narrative-identity tradition opens space for thoughtful qualitative work uncommon in PAID or JPSP.

### Best Suited For

- Big Five / HEXACO personality research
- Narrative identity studies (McAdams approach)
- Personality development across lifespan
- Dark Triad and personality-process research
- Longitudinal personality designs
- Theoretical personality contributions

### Not Recommended For

- Pure social psychology without personality angle (consider JPSP, PSPB)
- Applied I/O personality (consider Personnel Psych)
- Pure autoethnography

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Personality and Individual Differences](./personality-and-individual-differences.md) | Elsevier peer; broader individual-differences scope; ISSID |
| 2 | [European Journal of Personality](./european-journal-of-personality.md) | EAPP-affiliated; European personality community |
| 3 | [Journal of Research in Personality](./journal-of-research-in-personality.md) | Elsevier peer; personality research scope |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JPSP as "too personality-specialized," J Personality is the natural home — Wiley personality flagship with narrative-identity strength.
